acceptanceScenarios.expect: returns the API identity JSON without the Skill reading or exposing credentials
returns the authenticated media catalog only for explicit discovery, an installed-profile gap, or post-rejection diagnosis; it is not a normal media-submission preflight

acceptanceScenarios.request: POST the fixed Images or Videos API URL once with the installed selected model and declared request body
acceptanceScenarios.expect: normal core text generation submits directly without a catalog preflight and returns a JSON task response without changing the model or parameters

acceptanceScenarios.request: GET a submitted task's fixed full status or content URL
acceptanceScenarios.expect: continues only the supplied task_id and never submits a replacement task

acceptanceScenarios.request: GET a completed task's fixed full content URL
acceptanceScenarios.expect: returns or attaches native media bytes; URLs, HTML, SVG, task IDs, and status text are not completed delivery

userMediaInput.fallback: If the active runtime cannot send an explicitly attached file as the declared multipart representation, stop before submission, explain the declared transport, and do not invent a URL, file ID, or upload path. A public HTTPS URL, file ID, or voice ID explicitly supplied by the user may be sent only in the exact installed or on-demand-profile field whose declared transport permits it; the Skill never downloads, validates, or rehosts it.

mediaDeliveryResourceBounds.fallback: If native media bytes cannot be handed off, report same-task delivery as unavailable. Do not substitute a URL, HTML, SVG, status text, or a re-submitted task.

balance.fallback: If the direct balance request is not authenticated or cannot be executed, report the returned result and direct the user to the Pure Tokens client balance view; do not estimate or ask for credentials.
